title: Hugging Face Transformers
subtitle: Hugging Face Transformers is the training path for my capabilities model: a full fine-tune of every parameter, finished in minutes, rebuilt whenever the catalog changes.

stats.label: of the base's parameters in feed-forward layers

lede: Capabilities model holds an agent's tool catalog in the weights of a small model, and the catalog changes every week. If retraining took a day, the model would be stale on arrival. I chose a full fine-tune of every parameter of a small open-weight base model with Hugging Face Transformers, on a corpus generated from the tool registry. At this size the run takes minutes, so the model is rebuilt whenever the registry changes. I ran a full fine-tune over adapters, because at this size the cost that usually justifies adapters was absent and the full fine-tune removes a layer of indirection. I chose the base model by checking each candidate.
quote: I choose models by reading their architecture against the task, and I make training cheap enough to repeat on every catalog change.
evidence: LLM fine-tuning: a full fine-tune of every parameter of a small base model with Hugging Face Transformers, rebuilt whenever the tool catalog changes.
Model selection by architecture: candidates checked for feed-forward share (~44%), full attention on all 28 layers, remote code off and tokenizer fit, on a 360M, 0.6B and 1.7B capacity ladder.
Training-to-inference handoff: safetensors loaded into a custom CUDA decoding engine behind an FP32 parity check.
author: Corey James
